couplets.en: The whole world falls asleep.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle to come and meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle to come and meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.
Come when the veil of night stirs.

lines: Ye Taj Mahal jo chahat ki
couplets.en: Love looks upon this Taj Mahal.
It is a golden pearl in love's eyes.

lines: Har raat jahaan do roohon ki
couplets.en: Two souls come here each night.
Their silence comes alive.

lines: Taj ke saaye mein aa kar
couplets.en: Come into the shadow of the Taj.
Sing that song of devotion again.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle to come and meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.
Come when the veil of night stirs.
Solitude seems wide awake.
All around, the world seems asleep.
It is as though all this were in your dreams.
Come to the Taj Mahal.
Come when the veil of night stirs.
Death may come in the midst of love.

lines: Woh jaan se badh kar pyaari hai
couplets.en: Even that is dearer than life.

lines: Do pyaar bhare dil roshan hain
couplets.en: Two hearts full of love are alight.
The night is very dark.

lines: Tum raat ke is andhiyaare mein
couplets.en: Come through the darkness of this night.
Let me catch just one glimpse of you.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle to come and meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.
Come when the veil of night stirs.
And the whole world falls asleep.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle to come and meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.

lines: Tum Taj Mahal mein aa jaana
couplets.en: Come to the Taj Mahal.
